name: Shirokawa Yuzuki
source: A kind, friendly and trustwothy student who, by his father's orders, went to live by himself in a small Japanese city. Because of some (un)lucky events that occurs during his walk to his appartment, he has no choice but to work in a café with 4 girls around his age. Later, Yuzuki will learn more about his new coworkers' lifes and why they act and look so different from other people.
